corrections.reason: The printed word is ኦሪትን ('the Orit/Torah', contrasted with ወንጌል 'the Gospel'), where ኦሪ was visually misread as አና.
The archaic Andemta form printed on the page is ሁንኩ (with the 2nd-order Fidel ሁ clearly showing its horizontal side strokes), not modernized ሆንኩ.
Classical Ge'ez chapter heading 'ወኅፅበተ እገሪሆሙ' (and the washing of their feet) uses ፅ (ፀ ሳድስ), which is clearly visible in the image rather than ዕ.
Canonical Ge'ez Gospel of John 13:1 reads 'ወእምቅድመ በዓለ ፋሲካ ኮነ የአምር እግዚእ ኢየሱስ'; the printed ኮነ at the end of the line was misread as ነጎ.
